import 'dart:async';

const concurrency = 1;

Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

class Pool {
  int get concurrency => 4;

  Future<List<void>> run(
    List<int> items,
    Future<void> Function(int) operation,
  ) => mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, operation);
}

Future<void> main() async {
  var active = 0;
  var peak = 0;
  var completed = 0;
  await Pool().run(List.generate(8, (index) => index), (_) async {
    active++;
    if (active > peak) peak = active;
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 5));
    active--;
    completed++;
  });
  print('{"serialDefault":$concurrency,"peak":$peak,"completed":$completed}');
}
